# aion

> GPU-composited animation engine for a math/CS/physics explainer channel. Narration (ElevenLabs) gives
> word-level timing. Beats come from the words. Scenes are layer stacks (Manim, GLSL, Taichi sims, images)
> that are pure functions of audio time. Output is rendered in resumable chunks, muxed and audited. Python 3.12 + uv; CLI: `uv run aion …`.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): rules + reading order + command table (read first)
- [CHEATSHEET.md](CHEATSHEET.md): every common pattern, copy-paste ready
- `uv run aion catalog <query> [--full]`: signature + one-line doc for any name below
- `uv run aion docs <topic>`: the docs below; `llms-full.txt` holds everything in one file

- [docs/voice.md](docs/voice.md): ElevenLabs narration + word cues

- [docs/recipes.md](docs/recipes.md): math concept → visual technique
- [docs/troubleshooting.md](docs/troubleshooting.md): errors → fixes

## API
Everything is importable with `from aion import *` (which also re-exports Manim).

<!-- API:BEGIN (generated by `aion docs --build`) -->
### aion.comp
- `BLEND_MODES`: Layer `blend=` names: normal, add, screen (fast GL) + multiply, overlay, soft_light, difference, lighten, darken, color_dodge (shader).
- `Camera(moves: 'dict[str, list[_Move]]' = …, base: 'dict[str, float]' = …, shakes: 'list[tuple[float, float, float, float, int]]' = …) -> None`: Keyframed camera. Moves chain: each starts from where the previous ended.
- `Comp(size: 'tuple[int, int]' = (1920, 1080), fps: 'float' = 60, background=None, layers: 'Iterable[Layer]' = (), fx=(), camera: 'Camera | None' = None, frame_height: 'float' = 8.0, seed: 'int' = 0, **layer_kw)`: Layer stack → frame. A Comp is itself a Layer (use it as a precomp).
- `hex_to_linear(c) -> 'tuple[float, float, float]'`: '#rrggbb' / (r, g, b) sRGB 0-1 / ManimColor → linear RGB.

### aion.components
- `Eqn(tex: 'str', colors: 'dict[str, str] | None' = None, size: 'float | None' = None, **kw)`: MathTex with named terms isolated and colored by the theme (same color as their visuals).
- `Label(text: 'str', size: 'float | None' = None, color=None, weight: 'str' = 'NORMAL', **kw)`: Body-font text at a phone-legible size.
- `Title(text: 'str', size: 'float | None' = None, color=None, **kw)`: Display-font title placed inside the top safe margin.

### aion.core
- `Clock(rate=1.0, start: 'float' = 0.0, end: 'float | None' = None, step: 'float' = 0.0020833333333333333)`: Integrated time: clock(t) = ∫ rate(τ) dτ from `start` (0 before start).
- `EASES`: Named easing curves accepted by every `ease=`: smooth, easy_ease, snap, out_back, spring, …
- `cubic_bezier(x1: 'float', y1: 'float', x2: 'float', y2: 'float') -> 'Ease'`: CSS / After Effects cubic-bezier timing curve (solved by lookup table).
- `ease(e: 'str | Ease | None') -> 'Ease'`: Resolve a name / callable / None (→ smooth) to an easing function.
- `spring(damping: 'float' = 0.55, freq: 'float' = 2.2) -> 'Ease'`: Damped spring settling at 1 (natural overshoot). damping in (0, 1).
- `steps(n: 'int') -> 'Ease'`: Hold-frame staircase with n steps (stop-motion / counters).
- `fbm1(x: 'float', seed: 'int' = 0, octaves: 'int' = 4) -> 'float'`: Fractal sum of noise1 (roughly in [-1, 1]).
- `hash01(*ints: 'int') -> 'float'`: Stateless integer hash → [0, 1).
- `noise1(x: 'float', seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'float'`: Smooth 1D value noise in [-1, 1] (quintic interpolation of hashed lattice).
- `rng(*seed: 'int') -> 'np.random.Generator'`: Seeded numpy Generator (use for scene setup; never at render time without a seed).
- `shake(t: 'float', amp: 'float' = 0.02, freq: 'float' = 9.0, seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'tuple[float, float]'`: Handheld-style 2D offset at time t (pure).
- `simplex2(x: 'float', y: 'float', seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'float'`: 2-D OpenSimplex noise in [-1, 1] (deterministic per seed).
- `simplex3(x: 'float', y: 'float', z: 'float', seed: 'int' = 0) -> 'float'`: 3-D OpenSimplex noise in [-1, 1]; use z = time for evolving 2-D noise.
- `FrameGrid(fps: 'float' = 60) -> None`: Maps between seconds and frame indices at `fps`.
- `TimeRange(start: 'float', end: 'float') -> None`: Half-open [start, end) interval in seconds.
- `set_lead(seconds: 'float') -> 'None'`: Change the global default lead used by `at=` everywhere.
- `Track(fn: 'Callable[[float], Any]', active: 'Sequence[tuple[float, float]] | None' = None, label: 'str' = '')`: Callable value-over-time with known change intervals.
- `const(v) -> 'Track'`: A value that never changes.
- `fade(at: 'float', to: 'float' = 1.0, dur: 'float' = 0.6, out: 'float | None' = None, out_dur: 'float | None' = None, ease='smooth', lead: 'float | None' = None) -> 'Track'`: 0 → `to` landing on `at`; optionally back to 0 landing on `out`.
- `key(at: 'float', a, b, dur: 'float' = 1.0, ease='smooth', lead: 'float | None' = None) -> 'Track'`: Hold `a`, move to `b` over `dur` seconds landing on beat `at`, then hold `b`.
- `keys(*frames: 'tuple', default_ease='smooth', dur: 'float | None' = None, lead: 'float | None' = None) -> 'Track'`: Keyframes `(t, value[, ease])` sorted by time; values interpolate between keys.
- `lerp(a, b, u)`: Linear interpolation that works for scalars, arrays and nested lists.
- `pulse(at: 'float', amp: 'float' = 1.0, dur: 'float' = 0.6, base: 'float' = 0.0) -> 'Track'`: A bump base → base+amp → base, peaking exactly on the beat.
- `ramp(t0: 'float', t1: 'float', a: 'float' = 0.0, b: 'float' = 1.0, ease='linear') -> 'Track'`: a → b between absolute times t0 and t1 (no lead; for long continuous motion).
- `track(x) -> 'Track'`: Coerce a number / array / callable(t) / Track into a Track.
- `wave(freq: 'float' = 1.0, amp: 'float' = 1.0, phase: 'float' = 0.0, base: 'float' = 0.0, during: 'tuple[float, float] | None' = None) -> 'Track'`: base + amp·sin(2π·freq·t + phase): idle breathing / oscillation (pure in t).

### aion.fx
- `Effect(**params)`: Base effect. Subclasses implement apply(); params given as Tracks.
- `Bloom(strength=0.35, threshold=0.8, knee=0.4, radius=5, tint='#ffffff')`: Highlights bleed light (dual-Kawase pyramid).
- `Blur(radius=2.0)`: Gaussian-like blur; radius 0 = off (animate for focus pulls).
- `ChromaticAberration(amount=0.3) -> 'Lens'`: RGB fringing toward the edges (use sparingly: impact moments).
- `Glow(color=None, strength=1.0, radius=4)`: Coloured halo from the layer's own shapes (neon / emphasis).
- `Grade(exposure=0.0, contrast=1.0, saturation=1.0, lift=0.0, gamma=1.0, gain=1.0, tint=(1.0, 1.0, 1.0), lut: 'str | None' = None, lut_mix=1.0)`: Primary colour grade in linear light, optional .cube LUT.
- `Grain(amount=0.025, size=1.0) -> 'Lens'`: Film grain, deterministic per frame index.
- `Lens(vignette=0.0, ca=0.0, grain=0.0, grain_size=1.0, roundness=1.0)`: Vignette + chromatic aberration + grain in one pass (cheapest finish).
- `Vignette(amount=0.25, roundness=1.0) -> 'Lens'`: Darken the frame edges (draws the eye to the centre).
- `ZoomBlur(amount=0.15, center=(0.5, 0.5), taps: 'int' = 16)`: Radial blur from `center` (uv). amount 0 = off; animate for whoosh transitions.

### aion.gpu
- `gl()`: The process-wide moderngl context (created on first call).

### aion.layers
- `Layer(*, z: 'float' = 0.0, start: 'float' = -inf, end: 'float' = inf, opacity=1.0, blend: 'str' = 'normal', fx=(), matte: "'Layer | None'" = None, matte_mode: 'str' = 'alpha', parallax: 'float' = 1.0, pos=(0.0, 0.0), scale…)`: Base layer. See module docstring for shared parameters.
- `Surface(tex: 'Any', enc: 'int' = 0, extent: 'tuple[float, float] | None' = None, screen_rot: 'float' = 0.0) -> None`: A layer's pixels for one frame.
- `ManimLayer(**kw)`: Transparent Manim layer driven by a score of timed events. See module docstring.
- `ArrayLayer(rgba: 'np.ndarray', height: 'float' = 8.0, premultiplied: 'bool' = False, **kw)`: An RGBA uint8 numpy image (sRGB, straight alpha unless premultiplied=True).
- `ImageLayer(path: 'str | Path', height: 'float' = 4.0, **kw)`: An image file (PNG/JPG) placed in world space, `height` in Manim units.
- `FieldLayer(field: 'Callable[[float], np.ndarray]', cmap: 'str' = 'inferno', vmin: 'float' = 0.0, vmax: 'float' = 1.0, extent=(14.222, 8.0), center=(0.0, 0.0), colors=('#2b6cb0', '#0d1117', '#ff7a59'), alpha=1.0, contours: 'floa…)`: A scalar field `field(t)` → (ny, nx) array (row 0 = bottom) shown with a colormap.
- `PointsLayer(positions: 'Callable[[float], np.ndarray]', values: 'Callable | None' = None, color='#58c4dd', size: 'float' = 3.0, glow: 'float' = 0.4, alpha=1.0, cmap: 'str | None' = None, vmin: 'float' = 0.0, vmax: 'float' = 1.0,…)`: Point sprites at world positions from `positions(t)` → (N, 2|3) array.
- `ShaderLayer(frag: 'str', *, scale_res: 'float' = 1.0, animated: 'bool | None' = None, **kw)`: Full-frame GLSL layer. `animated` is auto-detected from u_time/u_local use.
- `Gradient(a='#1a2330', b='#06080b', radial: 'bool' = True, center=(0.0, 0.0), radius: 'float' = 8.0, direction=(0.0, 1.0), alpha: 'float' = 1.0, **kw)`: Linear or radial gradient between two sRGB colors (world space, Manim units).
- `Solid(color='#000000', **kw)`: Flat color filling the frame (linear-light compositing of an sRGB color).

### aion.render
- `Encoder(path: 'str | Path', size: 'tuple[int, int]', fps: 'float', codec: 'str' = 'final', alpha: 'bool' = False, crf: 'int' = 16, audio: 'str | Path | None' = None, audio_offset: 'float' = 0.0, duration: 'float | None' = No…)`: Stream RGB(A) frames into ffmpeg (x264 final / ultrafast preview / ffv1 / png), optionally muxing audio.
- `Video(theme: 'object' = None, fps: 'float' = 60, size: 'tuple[int, int]' = (1920, 1080), title: 'str' = '', background: 'str | None' = None, extra: 'dict' = …) -> None`: Declared in videos/<slug>/video.py.
- `load_video(ref, size: 'tuple[int, int] | None' = None, fps: 'float | None' = None, only: 'list[str] | None' = None) -> 'LoadedVideo'`: Import a video folder. `only` limits which scene files are imported (by prefix).
- `SceneBuilder(sd: 'SceneDef', comp: 'Comp')`: Passed to every @scene function. Adds layers clipped to the scene's range.
- `scene(start: 'float', end: 'float', **options)`: Register a scene covering absolute audio times [start, end).

### aion.sim
- `Sim(seed: 'int' = 0, **params)`: Base simulation. Params are constructor kwargs (stored for the cache key).
- `SimCache(data: 'dict[str, np.ndarray]', start: 'float', rate: 'float') -> None`: Baked samples: arrays shaped (n_samples, ...) on a regular time grid.
- `bake(sim: 'Sim', start: 'float', end: 'float', rate: 'float' = 60, name: 'str | None' = None) -> 'SimCache'`: Run `sim` from `start` to `end`, sampling `rate` times per second (cached).
- `Heat2D(nx=256, ny=144, k: float = 0.2, init: str = 'spot', seed: int = 0)`: Explicit heat diffusion from an initial hot pattern (`init`: 'spot' | 'bars').
- `NBody(n: int = 256, g: float = 0.6, soft: float = 0.08, radius: float = 3.0, spin: float = 0.6, dim: int = 2, seed: int = 0)`: Softened Newtonian gravity in 2D (or 3D with dim=3), leapfrog integrator.
- `Particles(n: int = 20000, flow: float = 0.6, scale: float = 0.35, gravity: float = 0.0, drag: float = 0.6, box=(7.1, 4.0), seed: int = 0)`: Many particles advected by curl noise + gravity + drag, wrapped in the frame box.
- `Springs(nx: int = 24, ny: int = 16, size=(6.0, 4.0), stiffness: float = 900.0, gravity: float = 4.0, wind: float = 1.2, seed: int = 0)`: Mass-spring cloth (structural + shear springs), Verlet, top row pinned, wind gusts.
- `Wave2D(nx=256, ny=144, c: float = 0.45, damping: float = 0.15, drops=((0.0, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0),), seed: int = 0)`: Damped wave equation; `drops` = [(t, x_uv, y_uv, amp)] pluck the surface.

### aion.sync
- `Beat(t: 'float', name: 'str' = '', end: 'float | None' = None, text: 'str' = '', soft: 'bool' = False)`: A time in seconds that remembers which words it came from.
- `Beats(items: 'dict[str, Beat]', duration: 'float', fps: 'float' = 60, cue: 'Cue | None' = None, source: 'str' = '') -> None`: Resolved beat table. Attribute access: `T.name`. Also `T.start`, `T.end`, `T.cuts`.
- `beats(_cue: 'Cue | str | Path | None' = None, *, fps: 'float' = 60, audio: 'str | Path | None' = None, _video=None, **specs: 'str | Spec') -> 'Beats'`: Resolve named beats in order. See module docstring.
- `cut(before: 'str', after: 'str') -> 'Spec'`: Scene boundary between the end of `before` and the start of `after`, placed in the middle of the real audio silence there and snapped to the frame grid.
- `end(text: 'str', offset: 'float' = 0.0, nth: 'int' = 1) -> 'Spec'`: End of phrase `text` (+offset).
- `sec(t: 'float') -> 'Spec'`: An explicit time in seconds (avoid: prefer words).
- `w(text: 'str', offset: 'float' = 0.0, nth: 'int' = 1) -> 'Spec'`: Start of phrase `text` (+offset). `nth` skips earlier matches after the cursor.
- `Cue(words: 'list[Word]')`: Indexed word timeline loaded from a word-level SRT or words.json, with in-order phrase search.
- `Cursor(cue: 'Cue', after: 'float' = 0.0)`: Ordered lookups: each `at()` searches after the previous match's start.
- `Word(text: 'str', start: 'float', end: 'float') -> None`: One narrated word with absolute start/end seconds.
- `norm(word: 'str') -> 'str'`: Matching key: lowercase, letters/digits only ("Don't," → "dont").
- `check_contiguous(ranges: 'list[tuple[str, float, float]]', duration: 'float', fps: 'float' = 60) -> 'None'`: Raise if scene ranges `(name, start, end)` leave gaps/overlaps or miss the audio ends.
- `suggest_cuts(cue: 'Cue', sil: 'list[tuple[float, float]]', min_silence: 'float' = 0.3) -> 'list[dict]'`: Sentence ends followed by a real silence ≥ min_silence: natural scene boundaries.
- `audio_duration(path: 'str | Path') -> 'float'`: Duration in seconds, from decoded sample count (cached by file hash).
- `load_audio(path: 'str | Path', rate: 'int' = 16000) -> 'np.ndarray'`: Decode any audio file to mono float32 at `rate` Hz (PyAV).
- `silences(path: 'str | Path', db: 'float' = -38.0, min_len: 'float' = 0.18, rate: 'int' = 16000, win: 'float' = 0.01) -> 'list[tuple[float, float]]'`: Spans quieter than `db` dBFS (relative to the 99th-percentile level) lasting ≥ min_len s.

### aion.theme
- `BASE`: Semantic design tokens (colors are sRGB hex).
- `C`: Active theme tokens: C.bg, C.text, C.accent, C.<your role>, sizes, lead, bloom… (read at call time).
- `Theme(bg: 'str' = '#0d1117', bg2: 'str' = '#161b22', text: 'str' = '#e6edf3', muted: 'str' = '#8b949e', faint: 'str' = '#30363d', accent: 'str' = '#58c4dd', accent2: 'str' = '#f2c14e', good: 'str' = '#7ee787', bad: 'str' =…)`: Semantic design tokens (colors are sRGB hex).

### aion.voice
- `VoiceSettings(voice_id: 'str' = 's3TPKV1kjDlVtZbl4Ksh', model_id: 'str' = 'eleven_v4', output_format: 'str' = 'mp3_44100_128', stitch: 'bool' = True, seed: 'int | None' = 7, settings: 'dict' = …) -> None`: Voice/model choice. Override per video in `videos/<slug>/voice.toml`.
<!-- API:END -->
